title: 3452. Sum of Good Numbers

examples.explanation: The good numbers are nums[1] = 3, nums[4] = 5, and nums[5] = 4 because they are strictly greater than the numbers at indices i - k and i + k.
The only good number is nums[0] = 2 because it is strictly greater than nums[1].
